flows.name: Generate the codebook (static trace; not executed for this atlas)

steps.text: An intentional source-vocabulary change is followed by `python3 scripts/generate_codebook.py`; the main guard dispatches main(), which parses --check and calls load_rows().

sources.anchor: Regenerate the codebook after an intentional source CSV change:

steps.text: load_rows() resolves the CSV relative to the script repository root, hashes its bytes, and parses UTF-8-with-optional-BOM CSV. Missing source, missing required fields, empty input, blank IDs, and duplicate IDs take explicit error exits.
render() builds the manual from loaded rows and their digest, including global evidence defaults and per-pattern sections. Without --check, main() writes UTF-8 CODEBOOK.md and reports completion.

flows.name: Check codebook consistency (static trace; not executed for this atlas)

steps.text: The documented review command is `python3 scripts/generate_codebook.py --check`. It uses the same CSV loading and rendering path before entering the read-only comparison branch.
A missing codebook or exact-text mismatch exits with error status 1; stale output names the regeneration command. Matching output prints the pattern count and returns 0.
